project.name: RuneGrove
project.summary: Fan-run lore archive and hub for the Runeterra universe and Riot's unannounced MMO; also card/voice-line database, audio drama section, mini games, guides and tools.

about.text: Fan-run lore archive and hub for the Runeterra universe and Riot's unannounced MMO; also card/voice-line database, audio drama section, mini games, guides and tools.

coverage.text: Page counts: 1,763 lore works; 542 codex entries; 142 mapped places; 177 champions; 13 zones; 2,153 3D models; 4,227 cards; 74,157 voice lines; 180 Riot MMO dispatches.

tests.inputs: fact as shown: /champions page lists the playable roster; page url: https://runegrove.com/champions
tests.expected: All 173 champions in Data Dragon 16.23.1 (incl. new Locke, Zaahen, Yunara, Mel)

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Champion titles on /champions (e.g. 'The Darkin Blade', 'Matriarch Of War'); page url: https://runegrove.com/champions
tests.actual: 173 of 173 titles identical when case is ignored (the site Title-Cases every word, e.g. 'Of', 'The')

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Demacia region page: 15 champions (Fiora, Galio, Garen, Jarvan IV, Kayle, Locke, Lux, Morgana, Poppy, Quinn, Shyvana, Sona, Sylas, Vayne, Xin Zhao); page url: https://runegrove.com/regions/demacia
fact as shown: Noxus region page: 17 champions; page url: https://runegrove.com/regions/noxus
tests.expected: Ambessa, Briar, Cassiopeia, Darius, Draven, Katarina, Kled, LeBlanc, Mel, Mordekaiser, Rell, Riven, Samira, Sion, Swain, Talon, Vladimir

tests.inputs: fact as shown: News post (17 Nov 2026): 'Riot Is Overhauling League of Legends for 2027. New Dawn Brings a New Client, a Revamped Summoner's Rift...'; page url: https://runegrove.com/
tests.expected: Riot revealed 'League of Legends: New Dawn' at the Worlds 2026 final (14 Nov): modernised client, refreshed Summoner's Rift, 2027
tests.actual: post dated 17 Nov (3 days after the reveal)

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Home page 'Hero' counts '177 champions' vs /champions 'All Regions 220' vs Data Dragon 173; page url: https://runegrove.com/
tests.actual: 177 on the home page; 220 on /champions (includes TFT/other units such as Zippy, Baron Nashor, Rift Herald)

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Claim: '1,763 lore works, 542 codex entries, 142 mapped places, 177 champions'; old and new champions; page url: https://runegrove.com/
tests.expected: Old (Annie, Alistar, Ashe, 2009) and new (Locke, Zaahen, Yunara, Mel) champions present with titles; latest news dated 23 Nov 2026
tests.actual: Old and new champions all present; counts of works/entries/places not verifiable
